normalization.overview: Count Grey Matter connects Anthropic policy and interpretability research with questions about emotion-like representations, model welfare and consciousness.
normalization.whyItMatters: Useful for readers separating functional behavior from moral status. Watch the experimental discussion; skip it if you need proof of consciousness or an independent replication.
normalization.ghostMeshTakeaway: Treat internal mechanisms, welfare hypotheses and operational authority separately. Test behavior and policy boundaries without giving a model authority over its supervision.
normalization.falsification: Reconsider the recommendation if a controlled comparison on the stated task shows no benefit, or exposes permission failures, omitted evidence or greater cost than the ordinary workflow. See the original article for its specific proposed controls.
normalization.freshness: Historical references in this Reader were checked October 18, 2026. The Anthropic policy announcement was checked October 19, 2026 for the narrowly bound claims below. This revision did not re-transcribe the source video, replicate a study, or verify later operational outcomes.
